decisions.reason: The same source message already has a complete candidate MODIFY that changes the immediate Lead Clipper assignment into a future pathway after the new trial and monthly role.
The same source message already introduces the 125-approved-clips-per-month quota; the qualification change requires no additional update to that quota.
The new three-clip qualification trial does not specify a different submission channel or review-submission workflow.
Requiring three perfect qualification clips changes the trial threshold but does not necessarily alter the existing strong-moment selection criterion.
The source message does not identify new permitted content sources or change the existing topic constraint.
The revised qualification process does not modify or revoke the caption-color standard.
The revised qualification process does not change the required 30-to-90-second clip duration.
The phrase three perfect clips does not necessarily replace or modify the existing clean-editing requirement.
